v.intro: Codes a guest types at the login page instead of a phone number.
v.provenance: Device MAC and IP are recorded by the network for the most recent session that used each code. A code used more than once shows a +N badge and may have run on other devices. Anything a guest typed at the portal is self-reported and is not shown here.
v.sessionTimeoutHint: How long each login lasts. Blank means the full validity. Every login uses one of Max Uses, so raise Max Uses to allow more logins.
v.sessionTimeoutInvalid: Must be between 1 minute and the validity.
v.validityAruba: The guest's session ends after this time unless you set a shorter session timeout. 1440 minutes is 24 hours.
